key.name: local-server
key.summary: Read T3 Code on this computer

key.name: servers
key.summary: Other T3 servers (JSON array of id, name and url); their tokens are in ~/.config/t3-ai-usage/tokens

key.name: account-order
key.summary: Account order in the menu and the top bar (account keys)

key.name: panel-accounts
key.summary: Accounts shown in the top bar (account keys)

key.name: labels
key.summary: Short top-bar labels by account key; missing keys use the default

key.name: hidden-windows
key.summary: Limit windows hidden from the top bar and the menu ("account key|window id")

key.name: show-label
key.summary: Show the account label before the ring

key.name: show-percent
key.summary: Show the percentage left of the fullest window

key.name: reset-mode
key.summary: When to show the time until the fullest window resets

key.name: round-times
key.summary: Round times to their largest unit (16h instead of 15h59m)

key.name: known-accounts
key.summary: Accounts seen in the last 30 days (JSON, written by the extension for the preferences)
